_about: Table 2 of 6: roll tables (#193). Rolled once, when an item is created, in this order: quality -> stat roll within quality -> growth potential -> modifiers (modifiers.json). Equip, stash, travel and reload never reroll. Coefficients are ChatGPT's illustrative seeds plus Claude's proposals: for review, not approved balance.

quality._about: Starting quality: how well it was made. Fixed for the item's life (a proposal: not repairable condition; see the spec). Weights are among equipment drops.

body._about: Flat armour is very strong against small enemy damage ranges, so quality changes health and handling, not armour.

quality._decided: Owner, 2026-10-31: these effects as proposed; fixed starting quality (no wear, breakage or repair).

stat_roll._about: Small variation within a quality, so two 'fine' swords differ a little. Weapons: the top of the damage range and accuracy in percentage points. Armour: health.

growth._about: Growth potential, rolled once at creation and shown on the item: how much each mastery level adds. Owner, 2026-10-31: not tied to quality - every piece has the same odds of slow, steady or swift growth.

modifier_count._about: How many modifiers by region tier (separate from drop chance and from quality).

formulas.weapon_damage: base range + quality damage + stat roll (max only) + floor(mastery * damage growth); shift both ends, min >= 1, min <= max
formulas.weapon_accuracy: base accuracy + quality accuracy + stat roll + mastery * accuracy growth + modifiers; added to the hero's accuracy inside the game's existing hit chance (strain, light, webs, 10%-95% clamp)
formulas.body_health: quality health + stat roll + floor(mastery * health growth) + modifiers
formulas.body_handling: initiative penalty + quality handling - floor(mastery * handling growth), never below 0
